take.title_zh: AI 設計工具競爭白熱化：Figma 守陣、Anthropic 攻城
take.title_en: AI Design Tools Enter Full Battle Mode
take.body_zh:
2026 年的設計工具市場，正在經歷一場前所未有的平台重組。Figma 以 Q1 營收 3.33 億美元、年增 46% 的成績宣示防守優勢，同時引入 OpenAI Codex 與 Claude Code，讓 AI agent 直接在 canvas 內執行設計任務。另一頭，Anthropic 以 Claude Design 正面挑戰 Figma 與 Canva，主張「不需要受過訓練的設計師」就能產出可互動的原型。

這場競爭最值得設計師關注的，不只是工具功能的比拼，而是工作流程的根本假設正在改變：過去設計工具是「輔助設計師輸出」，現在 AI 開始嘗試「取代設計師初稿」。未來留給人類設計師最有價值的工作，可能是判斷力、品味與策略——而不是執行操作本身。
take.body_en:
The design tool market is undergoing a structural shift in 2026. Figma posted $333M in Q1 revenue — up 46% YoY — while simultaneously integrating OpenAI Codex and Claude Code as in-canvas AI agents. Meanwhile, Anthropic's Claude Design directly challenges Figma and Canva by letting anyone produce interactive prototypes without design training.

The deeper story isn't feature competition — it's a shift in the foundational assumption of design tools. Tools used to amplify designers; now AI is attempting to replace the first draft entirely. The most defensible work for human designers going forward may be judgment, taste, and strategy — not execution.

articles.title_zh: Figma 正式推出原生 AI 設計 Agent，Q1 營收年增 46% 達 3.33 億美元
articles.title_en: Figma Launches Native AI Design Agent as Revenue Surges 46% to $333M
articles.summary_zh: Figma 宣布推出原生 AI Design Agent，使用者可透過自然語言指令在協作 canvas 上建立新設計、修改既有稿件或自動化設計任務。同一週，Figma 公布 2026 年 Q1 財報：營收 3.33 億美元，年增 46%，顯示即便面對 Anthropic Claude Design 等競爭威脅，Figma 的核心商業表現仍然強健。公司同步宣布與 OpenAI（Codex）及 Anthropic（Claude Code）建立合作，讓這兩套 AI agent 工具直接整合進 Figma 工作流程，強化「設計即程式」的敘事。
articles.summary_en: Figma launched a native AI Design Agent that lets users create, modify, and automate design tasks via natural-language prompts directly inside the collaborative canvas. The announcement coincided with Figma's Q1 2026 earnings: $333.4M in revenue, up 46% YoY, signaling strong business fundamentals despite intensifying AI competition. Figma also confirmed partnerships with OpenAI (Codex) and Anthropic (Claude Code), embedding both agents into its design workflow to reinforce its "design-to-code" positioning.
articles.take_zh: Figma 以「我也有 AI agent」加上亮眼財報同時出牌，是典型的防守型發布：用成長數字穩定市場信心，再用 agent 整合封堵新進者。但關鍵問題是：Figma 的 AI agent 是真正改變工作流，還是功能包裝？
articles.take_en: Pairing strong earnings with an AI agent launch is classic defensive positioning — Figma signals financial health while closing the feature gap. The real question: does Figma's agent genuinely reshape workflows, or is it feature packaging to counter Claude Design's narrative?

articles.title_zh: Figma 與 OpenAI、Anthropic 合作，將 AI agent 整合進設計工作流
articles.title_en: Figma Partners With OpenAI and Anthropic to Bring AI Agents Into Design Workflows
articles.summary_zh: Figma 正式宣布與 OpenAI 及 Anthropic 建立策略合作，將兩家公司的 AI agent 工具——OpenAI Codex 與 Anthropic Claude Code——直接整合進 Figma 的設計環境。使用者可在 Figma canvas 內以自然語言呼叫這些 agent，執行從設計生成到程式碼輸出的自動化任務。此舉被業界解讀為 Figma 同時「對抗」與「擁抱」AI 競爭者的雙重策略：一方面保有平台中心位置，另一方面借助外部 AI 能力加速自身產品演化。
articles.summary_en: Figma officially partnered with OpenAI and Anthropic, integrating Codex and Claude Code directly into its design environment. Users can now invoke these AI agents via natural language within the Figma canvas to automate tasks from design generation to code output. Analysts read this as Figma's dual strategy: stay platform-central while borrowing external AI horsepower to accelerate its own evolution — competing with and embracing its AI rivals simultaneously.
articles.take_zh: Figma 同時與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 合作，等於在自家平台上引進競爭者的技術。這是聰明的平台策略：讓使用者留在 Figma 的 canvas，而不是跑去對手的工具。
articles.take_en: Integrating both OpenAI and Anthropic inside Figma's canvas is smart platform strategy — keep users in Figma's ecosystem rather than letting them migrate to standalone AI design tools. The risk: if the agents get good enough, the canvas itself becomes commoditized.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Design：用對話生成可互動原型，直接挑戰 Figma
articles.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Design: Prompt-to-Prototype Tool That Challenges Figma
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 旗下 Anthropic Labs 部門推出 Claude Design，這是一款讓使用者透過對話指令產出設計稿、互動原型、簡報、行銷素材等視覺內容的 AI 工具，底層由 Claude Opus 4.7（同日發布）驅動。與 Figma、Canva 等傳統設計工具最大的差異在於：Claude Design 明確主張不需要受過訓練的設計師也能使用，定位為「從零到原型」的全流程 AI 工作台。Anthropic 表示，使用者可透過細粒度的編輯控制進一步精修 AI 輸出，不只是單次生成。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic Labs launched Claude Design, a conversational AI tool for producing designs, interactive prototypes, slide decks, and marketing collateral — powered by the simultaneously released Claude Opus 4.7. Unlike Figma or Canva, Claude Design explicitly targets non-designers, positioning itself as a zero-to-prototype AI workbench. Users can refine AI output through fine-grained editing controls rather than relying on single-shot generation.
articles.take_zh: Claude Design 最具顛覆性的不是功能，而是它的使用者假設：Anthropic 直接跳過設計師，瞄準「需要視覺產出但沒有設計技能」的廣大用戶。這是對 Canva 的正面挑戰，也是對 Figma 商業模式的側翼威脅。
articles.take_en: Claude Design's most disruptive claim isn't its features — it's its user assumption. By targeting non-designers explicitly, Anthropic flanks both Canva (direct competition) and Figma (whose model depends on trained designers paying for professional tools).

articles.title_zh: Anthropic Claude Design 上線：對標 Adobe 與 Figma 的 AI 設計平台
articles.title_en: Claude Design by Anthropic: A Figma and Adobe Rival Built on Claude
articles.summary_zh: The New Stack 深度分析 Anthropic Claude Design 的產品定位與競爭意涵。文章指出，Claude Design 不只是單一功能，而是 Anthropic 建立「創意 AI 工作站」生態的第一步，底層模型 Claude Opus 4.7 具備強化的視覺理解與生成能力。報導也分析 Claude Design 與 Adobe Firefly、Figma AI 的差異：Adobe 深耕專業創作者、Figma 專注協作流程，而 Claude Design 試圖從「對話即設計」切入，覆蓋更廣的潛在用戶群。
articles.summary_en: The New Stack analyzes Claude Design's positioning and competitive implications. The piece frames Claude Design not as a single feature but as Anthropic's first move toward a "creative AI workstation" ecosystem, powered by Claude Opus 4.7's enhanced visual understanding. The analysis contrasts Claude Design with Adobe Firefly (targeting pro creatives) and Figma AI (focused on collaborative workflows), noting Claude's "conversation-as-design" approach aims for a broader, less design-trained audience.
articles.take_zh: The New Stack 的框架很準：Claude Design 是 Anthropic 進入創意工具市場的「灘頭堡」，不是終點。後續若推出協作功能或版本管理，才是真正與 Figma 正面交鋒的開始。
articles.take_en: The New Stack's framing is apt: Claude Design is Anthropic's beachhead into the creative tools market, not its endpoint. If Anthropic adds real-time collaboration or version control, that's when the direct Figma conflict begins in earnest.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 PM 每日實際使用的 15 款 AI 工具（實測整理）
articles.title_en: 15 AI Tools Product Managers Actually Use Daily in 2026 (Tested)
articles.summary_zh: ProdMgmt.world 整理了 2026 年 PM 實際高頻使用的 15 款 AI 工具，涵蓋自主執行（Claude Code）、市場研究（Perplexity、NotebookLM）、快速 UI 原型（Cursor、v0）、會議紀錄（Granola）、專案管理（Linear）、產品分析（PostHog）等類別。報告指出，2026 年最強的 PM AI 工具組合是「自主執行 + 引用式研究 + 產品遙測」的三角結構，並特別強調 Claude Code 在多步驟自動化工作流中的領先地位。
articles.summary_en: ProdMgmt.world tested and ranked 15 AI tools PMs use daily in 2026, spanning autonomous execution (Claude Code), cited research (Perplexity, NotebookLM), rapid UI prototyping (Cursor, v0), meeting intelligence (Granola), project management (Linear), and product analytics (PostHog). The report identifies the strongest PM AI stack as a triangle of autonomous execution + cited research + product telemetry, with Claude Code singled out for multi-step workflow automation.
articles.take_zh: 這份清單最有價值的不是工具本身，而是「三角結構」這個思維框架：自主執行、引用研究、產品遙測各司其職，缺一角就會出現工作流破口。值得對照自己的工具棧做盤點。
articles.take_en: The list's real value is the mental model: autonomous execution + cited research + product telemetry form a triangle where each leg serves a distinct function. Missing any one creates workflow gaps. Worth auditing your own PM stack against this framework.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年每個 PM 都需要的 AI 自主工作流
articles.title_en: The AI Product Management Workflows Every PM Needs in 2026
articles.summary_zh: Productside 分析 2026 年 PM 工作模式的核心轉變：從聊天式 AI 助手（問答型）進化到 agentic 工具（多步驟自主執行）。文章以 Claude Code、Manus、Claude Cowork 為例，說明這一代 AI 工具如何讓 PM 將整個工作流程——從需求分析到競品研究再到原型指令——委託給 AI agent 完成。報告同時警告：PM 若只使用聊天式 AI 而不擁抱 agentic 工具，將在效率與決策速度上落後。
articles.summary_en: Productside maps the 2026 shift in PM work: from chat-style AI assistants (Q&A) to agentic tools (multi-step autonomous execution). Using Claude Code, Manus, and Claude Cowork as examples, the piece shows how this generation of AI lets PMs delegate entire workflows — from requirements analysis to competitive research to prototype briefs — to AI agents. The report warns: PMs who stay in chat-mode AI will fall behind in both efficiency and decision velocity.
articles.take_zh: 這篇的核心論點值得認真對待：chat AI 和 agentic AI 不是新舊版本，而是根本不同的工作模式。前者是「問答工具」，後者是「可委派的同事」。PM 如果還在用 GPT 問問題，可能已經在落後了。
articles.take_en: The core argument deserves serious attention: chat AI and agentic AI aren't version upgrades — they're fundamentally different modes of work. One is a Q&A tool, the other is a delegatable colleague. PMs still using AI for Q&A may already be falling behind.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年，Product 正在發生什麼改變
articles.summary_zh: 資深產品顧問 Ant Murphy 在 Medium 發表長文，梳理 2026 年產品工作的結構性轉變。核心論點包括：AI 讓「交付速度」不再是競爭門檻，真正稀缺的是「正確的問題選擇」；PM 角色正從執行協調者轉向策略判斷者；產品發現（discovery）的重要性相對於交付（delivery）大幅上升。Murphy 認為，能在 AI 時代存活的 PM，是那些擅長定義「值得解決的問題」而不只是「如何更快解決問題」的人。
articles.summary_en: Product consultant Ant Murphy's Medium essay maps structural shifts in product work for 2026. Key arguments: AI has commoditized delivery speed, making problem selection the new competitive moat; PM roles are shifting from execution coordinators to strategic judgment-makers; and product discovery is rising sharply in value relative to delivery. Murphy's thesis: the PMs who survive the AI era are those skilled at defining which problems are worth solving, not just solving them faster.
articles.take_zh: Murphy 的框架提供了一個清晰的自我定位測試：你現在花在「發現問題」的時間，比花在「加速交付」的時間多嗎？如果答案是否定的，AI 時代的 PM 轉型可能還沒真正開始。
articles.take_en: Murphy's framework offers a simple self-audit: do you spend more time on discovery than delivery acceleration? If not, your PM transformation for the AI era may not have actually started yet.
